note: The locked 2026 individual field (30 men, 30 women) analyzed across the official Open (3 tests) and Quarterfinals (4 tests). Per-event scores are the official c3po results; placements are re-ranked within this 30-athlete Games field. Projected Form combines all 7 Open+QF tests as a data-driven proxy for Games form. The Games (July 22-26, San Jose) follow as live releases.

events.description: For time (12-min cap): an ascending-then-descending pyramid of wall-ball shots (20 lb to 10 ft) and box jump-overs (24 in). 354 reps = full workout completed; scores below the cap are rep counts.

For time (15-min cap): alternating single-arm dumbbell snatches, dumbbell overhead lunges, and pull-up/chest-to-bar/ring muscle-up progression of ascending gymnastic difficulty (50-lb DB for men). 132 reps = full workout completed.

For time (16-min cap): 6 rounds of burpees-over-the-bar, cleans, and thrusters with ascending barbell loads 95/115/135 lb across the rounds. 288 reps = 6 rounds complete; scores below that are rep counts.

events.name: QF Test 1
events.description: For time (12-min cap): 10 50-ft shuttle runs, 20 overhead squats (115 lb), 30 burpees-over-the-bar; then 1-min rest; then the movements in reverse order (burpees, OHS, shuttle runs).

events.name: QF Test 2
events.description: For time (15-min cap): 80 dumbbell hang squat cleans (50-lb DBs) and 40 bar muscle-ups, completed in any order/partitioning.

events.name: QF Test 3
events.description: For time (~12-min cap): couplet of double-unders and deadlifts with ascending loads across rounds (men approx 225/275/315 lb). Movement detail from secondary sources and uncertain (winning times ~3:55-4:00 suggest the published description may be incomplete); scores are from the official API.

events.name: QF Test 4
events.description: For time (20-min cap): 1,000-meter row, 30 clean and jerks (135 lb), 1,000-meter row, 30 strict handstand push-ups.
